cookies_titulo: Cookie Policy and Browser Local Storage
cookies_desc: At Estudio Cusihuaman, we prioritize the confidentiality of your financial data and instant loading speed. We do not use intrusive advertising tracking cookies nor sell your browsing history.
que_son_titulo: What are cookies and Local-First storage?
que_son_desc: Cookies and local storage (localStorage) are technical records stored by your browser on your device so you experience instant navigation, avoid logging in every visit, and preserve dark/light theme preferences.
nuestro_enfoque_titulo: Our Approach: Privacy by Design Without Trackers
nuestro_enfoque_desc: Unlike sites with invasive tracking, our web application installs no third-party ad pixels or tracking scripts. Operational data is handled securely within your own device browser.
tabla_titulo: Local Storage Inventory Used Across the Platform
clave_1_desc: Saves your visual preference between dark mode (futuro) and light mode (luz).
clave_2_desc: Maintains your secure session active as Client or Personnel at 0ms latency.
clave_3_desc: Local client-side cache of tax and accounting services for instant loading.
clave_4_desc: Reactive local storage of tax portfolio client records for the dashboard.
clave_5_desc: Local cache of official firm photography and media assets.
duracion_permanente: Persistent (Until the user signs out or clears browser data)
como_controlar_titulo: How can you manage or delete this data?
como_controlar_desc: You can clear storage for this site at any time through your browser's privacy settings (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox), or by simply logging out from the panel.
banner_mensaje: We use cookies to improve your experience and offer a transparent accounting service
